items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And I had a bass player in the band named Chris Roustion

ctx.x: Yeah. Too bad, because he really did have a lot on the ball, didn't he?

Yeah, he had a lot on the ball. And I had a bass player in the band named Chris Roustion, he was a big West Indian athlete, and was a bouncer. So (inaudible) get out of line, he was supposed to whip him. He was afraid of him. And he'd go (inaudible) go make a date drunk, he'd go there and break the door open, (inaudible). First he packed all his clothes, run all the women out of the room. He was scared of Chris. (Inaudible), you see. And that was his job, they were paying him extra to go roust him out.

And he'd go get the car and take him out, throw him across his shoulder and throw him in the car. And he finally got so he liked it. Let me get my clothes before this big sucker comes in here, this is my bodyguard. Get going, women. And he'd take and throw him in the car and drive him on off.
